segments.t: Max has been thinking, and he has a plan. He goes to Vika, and what he proposes is more than she expected. Take it in once, and don't worry about the details.
Вика, я тут подумал над твоими словами.
И что же ты надумал, Макс?
Я позвонил маме, родители скоро приедут.
Макс, ты это сейчас серьёзно говоришь?
Если не хватит денег, возьмём кредит.
В понедельник я к тебе перееду.
А если родится девочка, назовём Евгения.
Now the same thing, but slowly.
Вика, я тут подумал над твоими словами.

'Vika, I have been thinking about your words.' We hear 'thought over' is literally "thought above". After "above", the words for "your words" change their endings. We hear 'here' is a filler meaning "just now".
И что же ты надумал, Макс?
'And what did you come up with, Max?' When they say 'thought up' is When they say 'think' with a starting bit for a result. A little word adds "so" or "then". Vika waits to hear it.
Я позвонил маме, родители скоро приедут.
'I called mom, my parents are coming soon.' Notice the part 'rang to mum' changes the ending of "mum". Notice the part 'will arrive' is for arriving by car or train, not on foot.

'We will definitely have a big wedding!' Russians "play" a wedding: the action In Russian, 'we will play' translates is related to the action word "to play". In Russian, 'definitely' translates is used here. Max said it earlier to Kostya: "Then a wedding, and then children!".
Макс, ты это сейчас серьёзно говоришь?

'Max, are you saying this seriously right now?' Here, 'seriously' shows is from Vika's own earlier phrase "We need to talk seriously". Here, 'are you saying this' shows is literally "you this are saying". Vika is not sure he means it.
Если не хватит денег, возьмём кредит.

'If there is not enough money, we will take a loan.' The way to express 'money will not suffice' changes the form of The way to express 'money'. The way to express 'we will take' is followed by The way to express 'loan'.
В понедельник я к тебе перееду.

'On Monday I will move in with you.' 'on Monday' is used here uses 'in' is used here. 'I will move' is used here is formed with a starting bit meaning "across" plus the action word for riding. 'to you' is used here is used.

'We will wait for the baby together peacefully.' Listen to how 'wait for the baby' is literally "wait the baby", with no Listen to how 'for'. The words for "together" and "calmly" are also here. Max has it all planned.

'Wait, what baby are you talking about?' The speaker uses 'what other baby' matches the pattern of Vika's earlier phrase "What other secret?". The speaker uses 'wait' starts the sentence. Her tone changes at once.

'Maybe we will name him Zhenya?' The name is short for both Evgeny and Evgeniya, so it fits a boy or a girl. They express 'we will name' by is the action word in Barinov's earlier phrase "Name the exact price". They express 'maybe' by starts the sentence.

'It will be a handsome name — Evgeny Maksimovich!' A first name plus the father's name, like Dmitry Vladimirovich, is the polite form of address. The patronymic means "son of Maksim". We hear 'beautiful name' is also used.
А если родится девочка, назовём Евгения.
'And if a girl is born, we will name her Evgeniya.' When they say 'will be born' has a self-directed ending. When they say 'little girl' is used. The girl's name ends in an "a".

'Do you like this plan, darling?' Russian turns liking around: "to you the plan is pleasing", so the plan is the subject. Notice the part 'dear' is what Barinov called Vika earlier. Now put it all together.
Вика, я тут подумал над твоими словами.
И что же ты надумал, Макс?

Max is all in, and Vika asks which baby he means. The misunderstanding is about to be cleared up. Bye for now.
